name: manual_329984
claim: A driver that polls a buffered text pipe with select() and then readline() can miss a line already pulled into the buffer; read child output with a reader thread feeding a queue, or with unbuffered binary reads.
conditions: subprocess pipe select readline buffering test-harness

decisions.notes: Observed in a crash-window harness: a marker line that arrived in the same read as the previous line was never seen.

rationale: Observed in a crash-window harness: a marker line that arrived in the same read as the previous line was never seen.
